title: Sacred Ground Cosmic Campaigns
batch: Batch Two — More ideas that are wonderfully ridiculous
source: Founder Chat list + Cosmic Campaign Ideas screenshots
hard: Build from this list. Do not invent a different scene.
Never invent SACRED GROUND type. Stamp 21848 or 21849 on a blank bag, window, or sign.
Add the headline in the design pass.
Never the tarot Death card. If a tarot card appears, use The Star or The Sun only.
Circular sun is the corner mark only.

recurring_series.label: Sacred Ground: Cosmic Breaking News
recurring_series.idea: Fake intergalactic news bulletins reporting bizarre events at Sacred Ground. Vintage newsreels, dramatic announcers, outrageous cosmic discoveries.

recurring_series.label: Historical Figures Behaving Badly
recurring_series.idea: Da Vinci, Einstein, Cleopatra, Galileo, Newton and other legends discovering Sacred Ground across time.

recurring_series.label: Meanwhile, in Another Dimension…
recurring_series.idea: Impossible scenes where Sacred Ground exists in alternate realities: underwater Atlantis, a distant galaxy, prehistoric Earth, or the year 3026.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Saturn Has a Shopping Problem
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: Even Saturn Shops at Sacred Ground.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Saturn is parked above downtown Arlington Heights. Its rings are made entirely of crystals. A giant cosmic shopping bag hangs from the planet. Tiny spacecraft lined up outside the store waiting for parking.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: NASA Discovers a Portal in Arlington Heights
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: NASA Calls It An Anomaly. We Call It Tuesday.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: A colossal swirling wormhole opens above Sacred Ground. Astronauts, scientists, and news crews are staring at it.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: The Great Crystal Meteor Shower
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: We Told You New Inventory Was Coming.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Giant amethyst and quartz meteors streak across the night sky, landing gently outside Sacred Ground.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: The Aliens Finally Found Us
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: They Traveled 40 Light-Years for Our Crystal Selection.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: An enormous UFO hovers over Sacred Ground. A beam of light is lifting a gigantic amethyst geode into the spaceship.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Da Vinci's Secret Final Invention
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: 500 Years Ahead of His Time. Still Couldn't Find a Better Crystal Shop.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Leonardo stands before an enormous blueprint of a crystal-powered flying machine, covered in sacred geometry.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Einstein Finally Solves Everything
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: It's All Relative Except Great Crystals.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Einstein's chalkboard is filled with complicated equations. At the bottom, circled in chalk: E = SG².

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Cleopatra's Royal Shopping Expedition
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: She Ruled Egypt. But She'd Shop at Sacred Ground.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Cleopatra arriving in a golden chariot with celestial sphinxes, attendants carrying enormous crystals.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Newton Discovers Crystal Gravity
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: What Goes Up Must Come Down. Unless It's Our Energy.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Instead of an apple, a gigantic amethyst is falling toward Newton's head.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: The Galactic Octopus Wants a Reading
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: When You Have Eight Questions, One Reading Isn't Enough.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: A 300-foot cosmic octopus reaches down from another dimension, holding a different tarot card in each tentacle. NEVER Death.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: The World's Most Unusual Bank Robbery
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: They Left the Money. Took the Amethyst.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: Masked intergalactic thieves ignore stacks of cash and try to steal one enormous crystal.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: Houston, We Have Inner Peace
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: Houston, He's Not Coming Back. He Found His Center.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: An astronaut meditating on the moon while mission control frantically tries to reach him.

universe_lost_its_mind.label: The Universe Is Actually Run by a Cat
universe_lost_its_mind.headline: The Universe Has Spoken. It Wants More Crystals.
universe_lost_its_mind.visual: A colossal celestial cat sits on Earth like a toy, batting Saturn across the galaxy.

concepts.label: The Mona Lisa Escapes
concepts.headline: After 500 Years, She Finally Found Something to Smile About.
concepts.visual: The Mona Lisa steps out of her frame carrying a Sacred Ground shopping bag.

concepts.label: The Great Pyramid Delivery
concepts.headline: Your Crystal Order Has Arrived.
concepts.visual: A pyramid floats above downtown, carried by extraterrestrial drones.

concepts.label: The Black Hole Clearance Sale
concepts.headline: Some Attractions Are Stronger Than Gravity.
concepts.visual: A black hole sucks in everything except the Sacred Ground storefront.

concepts.label: Michelangelo's New Creation
concepts.headline: The Divine Touch. Now Available Downtown.
concepts.hold_why: Sistine Chapel / Creation of Adam is a Christian holy scene. Same class as retired Last Supper until Founder says go.
concepts.visual: HOLD. Sistine Chapel-inspired fresco, two hands passing a glowing amethyst.

concepts.label: The Galactic Traffic Jam
concepts.headline: Apparently Everyone Heard About Us.
concepts.visual: UFOs, dragons, flying carpets, and spaceships are all stuck in traffic outside Sacred Ground.

concepts.label: The Tarot Card That Escaped
concepts.headline: Your Future Is Looking Bigger Than Expected.
concepts.visual: A gigantic three-dimensional tarot card rises out of the pavement and towers above the town. NEVER Death. Use The Star only.

concepts.label: The Moon Has Moved
concepts.headline: Even the Moon Needed to Recharge.
concepts.visual: The moon is sitting in Sacred Ground's parking space with a parking ticket on it.

concepts.label: The Cosmic Vending Machine
concepts.headline: Choose Your Vibration.
concepts.visual: A vending machine the size of a skyscraper dispenses planets, stars, and crystals.

concepts.label: The Interdimensional Book Club
concepts.headline: Great Minds Think Beyond Time.
concepts.visual: Shakespeare, an alien, a medieval wizard, and a robot sit around a table reading metaphysical books.

concepts.label: The Crystal That Ate Chicago
concepts.headline: We May Have Ordered the Large.
concepts.visual: An enormous amethyst geode rises above the Chicago skyline.

concepts.label: The Universe's Lost & Found
concepts.headline: Find What You've Been Looking For.
concepts.visual: An enormous celestial lost-and-found counter holds missing stars, forgotten dreams, lost socks, and one glowing crystal.

concepts.label: The Cosmic TSA
concepts.headline: Ma'am, You'll Need to Explain the Amethyst.
concepts.visual: Alien airport security scans someone's luggage and discovers 47 crystals.

concepts.label: The Renaissance Reiki Session
concepts.headline: Even Royalty Needs to Unwind.
concepts.visual: An entire Renaissance court floats above the floor during a sound bath, wigs and robes suspended in midair.
